Buy Digital Urban Prints 18.06.2007 1 min read

Digital Urban Print Service

Andy CASA, UCL East


We now have over 100 panoramas on the pages of Digital Urban - a number of which we have hanging on the walls of the office.

As such we thought we would experiment with making a number of the images available for print via the Flickr linked server - ImageKind.

Available on both canvas and photographic paper the images can be purchased either as single prints or as fully framed images.

If you have any comments or would like to see any panoramas uploaded to the service than please get in touch.

As we said this is experimental but for the time being there is a chance to own some of our prints..

Click here to go direct to the gallery.
